_readme: Server-side strings that reach players: GameError messages, server-authored feed/flavor text (server/resources.ts). Keys are referenced as server.<key>.

starter.restHint: Open crafting (C) and make a sleeping bag from 4 fiber, step inside your tent and put it down, then click it to sleep. A night's rest refreshes every gathering spot in the preserve.
starter.plantHint: Dig a bed with your shovel (2), water it with the can (3), then stand on it and press E or Space to choose what to sow.
starter.harvestHint: Give your seedlings time to mature, then click a grown plant and pick its harvest — it regrows, so a planted meadow keeps paying.
starter.bugsHint: Bugs come back first — grasshoppers, bees, butterflies, ladybugs, spiders, snails. Plant flowers, place habitat, and watch who turns up. Your journal (J) says what each one is still waiting for.
starter.journal: Write up the Willow Meadow Field Guide
starter.journalHint: Open your tools (T) and write up the Willow Meadow Field Guide — it opens the full page for every animal of this meadow.
starter.buildTenHint: Open crafting (C). Every habitat piece you make and put down counts, and more recipes open as the meadow recovers.
starter.streamHint: Dig three beds in a row with your shovel (2), then water each one twice with the can (3) — the second pass floods a bed into open water. Chained tiles make a stream that water-loving animals need.
starter.homeHint: Open your home (from the camp tent) and pick a house to build. It needs the meadow healthy and the materials in your basket.

task.welcomeGrasshopperHint: Craft and place a grass patch, then bring the meadow to 8% health — the grasshopper hops home on its own.
task.welcomeNewAnimal: Welcome a new animal back to {biome}
task.welcomeAnyAnimal: Welcome a new animal, anywhere in the preserve
task.observe: Read about 3 animals in your journal
task.gatherHint: Select your basket (1), walk onto a glowing spot on the ground, and press E or Space.
task.craftFirstHint: Open crafting (C), pick something you can afford, and press Craft.

hint.craft: Open crafting (C) and make it — the hover box lists the materials it needs.
hint.build: Craft it (C), then place it out in the biome from the 'ready to place' bar.
hint.grow: Dig a bed (2), water it (3), then plant it from the bed's menu.
hint.plant: Dig a bed with the shovel, water it, then plant something living.
hint.collect: Gather this material from glowing spots out in the preserve.
hint.observe: Open an animal's entry in your field journal (J) to read about it.
hint.welcome: Build the habitat it needs — it returns on its own.
hint.attract: Build the habitat in the info box; the animal comes back on its own.
hint.welcomeTotal: Restore habitat across your biomes — animals return on their own.
hint.home: Use the sign by your camp tent to upgrade your home.
hint.tool: Gather the materials, then upgrade it from your toolbelt (Tools).
hint.unlock: Meet the requirements shown to open this biome.
hint.health: Heal the land — plant, water, and place habitat until this biome recovers.
hint.biomeAnimals: Build every animal's habitat here until the whole biome is home.

goal.upgradeGuide: Write up this area's Expanded Guide (Tools) for the exact list.

nextbiome.title: Unlock {biome}
nextbiome.hint: Tick off each requirement below to open {biome}.

unlockreward.title:
{biome} unlocked!
Claim your welcome bundle
unlockreward.hint: A handful of {biome} materials to get you started there.

whyReturned.sentence: Felt safe enough to return once {reasons}.
